title: SOC2 prep scratchpad - Jordan Patel
content:
Quick scratchpad for SOC2 prep 

Context / purpose:
- Working through control mapping & evidence for upcoming readiness review (internal dry-run planned early Dec).
- Focus: Security (primary), Availability, Confidentiality. Processing Integrity & Privacy TBD in next pass.
- Goal: produce a minimal evidence pack + narrative for each high-priority control.

High-level open questions (need answers before audit):
1) Service account MFA enforcement: are there service accounts that bypass MFA? Heard from infra (Noah) that legacy CI runner accounts are exempt - need a list and justification. (JIRA:SEC-142)
2) Backup/restoration evidence: we have daily snapshots for db-prod, but no recent restoration test doc - need a runbook + test result. Owner: Lena. Due: 2024-11-25.
3) Vendor risk docs: which third-party vendors have completed questionnaires? Missing: SSO provider attestation (Okta) and observability provider DPA. Owner: Asha.

Control mapping notes (rough):
- Access control (AC): IAM policies, Okta RBAC configs, SSO SAML logs, periodic access review notes (quarterly).
  - Evidence we have: IAM policy export (infra/github), Okta role list (export 2024-10-01), last access review notes (confluence link).
  - Gap: documented quarterly access review for service accounts (no evidence for Q2/Q3 2024). Action: schedule review + capture doc. Owner: Jordan / Noah.

- Change management (CM): PRs merged via protected branches, required approvals, release notes, deployment runbooks.
  - Evidence: GitHub branch protection settings screenshot, PR approval history (sample), deploy runbook for runtime (infra repo).
  - Gaps: formal change request logs (we rely on GitHub PRs - auditor asks for policy describing exceptions). Action: write short policy doc describing CR process and exceptions. Owner: Maya. Due: 2024-11-20.

- Logging & monitoring (LM): centralized logs in ELK/Datadog, retention policy, alerting coverage.
  - Evidence: retention policy doc, example alert -> incident ticket link, dashboard screenshots.
  - Gaps: retention justification for debug logs across staging vs prod (need short rationale).

- Vulnerability management (VM): weekly scans, CVE tracking, patching cadence.
  - Evidence: Nexpose/Qualys scan exports, monthly vuln tracker sheet, remediation tickets.
  - Gaps: documented SLA for patching critical vuln (need to formalize 72-hr SLA and capture board approvals). Owner: Eng Sec (Asha).

- Incident response (IR): IR playbooks, incident postmortems, notifier lists.
  - Evidence: 2 recent postmortems (2024-06 incident, 2024-09 outage), IR runbook (draft), PagerDuty rota export.
  - Gaps: evidence of IR tabletop exercise in last 12 months; I think we did informal run through in May but no writeup. Action: run a short tabletop and capture notes. Owner: Maya. Due: 2024-12-05.

Evidence checklist (what we can attach easily):
- IAM policy export (done) - attach GitHub link + screenshot
- Okta role export (done) - link
- Branch protection screenshot (done)
- Sample PR approvals (done) - selected PR ids list
- DB snapshot policy + retention (done) - need restoration test
- Backup restore runbook (missing) - Lena to create
- Vulnerability scan exports (done) - attach CSVs
- Postmortems (done) - redact PII and link
- Alerting dashboards (screenshots) - grab latest 2 weeks

Immediate action items (short):
- [ ] Compile list of service accounts exempt from MFA (Noah) - due 2024-11-22. Link to JIRA SEC-142.
- [ ] Create backup restoration test doc + evidence (Lena) - due 2024-11-25.
- [ ] Draft change request policy for exceptions (Maya) - due 2024-11-20.
- [ ] Vendor questionnaires follow-up: Okta attestation, observability DPA (Asha) - due 2024-11-28.
- [ ] Schedule tabletop IR exercise and write notes (Maya/Jordan) - target week of 2024-12-02.

Notes on evidence packaging strategy:
- Keep evidence minimal and cross-referenced: auditors want a narrative (1 page per control) + supporting artifacts. For each control: statement, mapping to internal policy/practice, list of artifacts, sample logs/PRs/tickets, owner contact.
- Use confluence template under linked_artifacts. I will draft the per-control 1-pagers starting with Access Control and Change Management first.

Sample narrative skeleton for AC-01 (Access provisioning/revocation):
- Statement: Access to production systems is provisioned via Okta + IAM with role-based access. Access is revoked via offboarding workflow in HR->Okta sync within 24 hours.
- Evidence: Okta user export (2024-10-01), offboarding ticket example (HR-321), last quarterly review notes (2024-09-15).
- Exceptions: service accounts managed in infra; list + justification attached.
- Controls tested: manual review of sample of 10 accounts (evidence: review notes).

Risk / things to watch (brain dump):
- Service accounts and CI runners are the common gotcha - need clear owner/justification and rotation policy for keys/credentials.
- Our use of multiple observability vendors creates complexity around retention and access; auditors may ask for consolidated vendor mapping.
- SRE-run ad-hoc DB restores: if we don't have structured test docs, auditors will call it a gap even if process exists informally.

Meeting notes from quick sync 2024-11-17 with Maya/Lena/Asha:
- Lena: will prioritize restore test + provide template by 11/22.
- Maya: will draft CR exception policy and schedule IR tabletop.
- Asha: vendor questionnaires - will escalate to procurement for missing vendor attestations.
- Noah: will produce service account list and confirm MFA exemptions.

Misc TODOs / next steps for me (Jordan):
- Draft two 1-pagers (Access Control, Change Management) by 2024-11-21 and link to Confluence template.
- Collate sample artifacts (PR ids, ticket ids, screenshots) into a single zip for reviewer.
- Validate retention policy language with Legal for confidentiality controls.

Random quick links I keep referencing (put here so I don't lose them):
- Confluence control inventory: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SOC2/Control+Inventory
- Infra repo PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pulls?q=is%3Apr+label%3Adeploy
- JIRA SEC board: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/RapidBoard.jspa?projectKey=SEC

Unresolved / low-priority:
- Privacy criteria mapping (defer until after core security controls are locked).
- Processing integrity: sample data pipeline checks - need SRE input; probably after CM mapping.

End of scratchpad. Will clean & move items into Confluence once the immediate actions are done.

-- Jordan
